verdict.rationale: Docs show a clear quickstart flow: create a feature flag in the Admin UI, connect an SDK, and toggle it via activation strategies without redeploying — and a runtime probe confirms an actual create-flag-and-evaluate loop working end-to-end within minutes on a fresh self-hosted instance. Missing for 10: independent third-party account of a brand-new signup-to-production toggle timing (only a self-hosted probe, not hosted SaaS signup, is verified).
